segments.an10.96:1.1: “Ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando rājagahe viharati tapodārāme.
segments.an10.96:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā ānando rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya yena tapodā tenupasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
segments.an10.96:1.3: Tapodāya [tapode (ka.)] gattāni parisiñcitvā paccuttaritvā ekacīvaro aṭṭhāsi gattāni pubbāpayamāno.
segments.an10.96:1.4: Kokanudopi kho paribbājako rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ paccuṭṭhāya yena tapodā tenupasaṅkami gattāni parisiñcituṃ.
segments.an10.96:2.1: Addasā kho kokanudo paribbājako āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ dūratova āgacchantaṃ.
segments.an10.96:4.1: “Puccheyyāma mayaṃ āyasmantaṃ kiñcideva desaṃ, sace āyasmā okāsaṃ karoti pañhassa veyyākaraṇāyā”ti.
segments.an10.96:5.1: “Kiṃ nu kho, bho,‘sassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti – evaṃdiṭṭhi [evaṃdiṭṭhiko (syā.)] bhavan”ti?
segments.an10.96:6.1: “Kiṃ pana, bho,‘asassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavan”ti?
segments.an10.96:7.1: “Kiṃ nu kho, bho, antavā loko … pe … anantavā loko … taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ … aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīraṃ … hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā … na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā … hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā … neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavan”ti?
segments.an10.96:7.10: ‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’”ti.
segments.an10.96:8.1: “Tena hi bhavaṃ na jānāti, na passatī”ti?
segments.an10.96:8.2: “Na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, na jānāmi na passāmi.
segments.an10.96:9.1: “‘Kiṃ nu kho, bho, sassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavan’ti, iti puṭṭho samāno –
segments.an10.96:9.3: ‘na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, evaṃdiṭṭhi – sassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti vadesi.
segments.an10.96:10.1: “‘Kiṃ pana, bho, asassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavan’ti, iti puṭṭho samāno –
segments.an10.96:10.3: ‘na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, evaṃdiṭṭhi – asassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti vadesi.
segments.an10.96:11.1: “Kiṃ nu kho, bho, antavā loko … pe … anantavā loko … taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ … aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīraṃ … hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā … na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā … hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā … neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññanti – evaṃdiṭṭhi bhavanti, iti puṭṭho samāno –
segments.an10.96:11.10: ‘na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, evaṃdiṭṭhi – neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti vadesi.
segments.an10.96:12.1: “‘Tena hi bhavaṃ na jānāti na passatī’ti, iti puṭṭho samāno –
segments.an10.96:12.2: ‘na kho ahaṃ, āvuso, na jānāmi na passāmi.
segments.an10.96:12.4: Yathā kathaṃ panāvuso, imassa bhāsitassa attho daṭṭhabbo”ti?
segments.an10.96:13.1: “‘Sassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti kho, āvuso, diṭṭhigatametaṃ.
segments.an10.96:13.2: ‘Asassato loko, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti kho, āvuso, diṭṭhigatametaṃ.
segments.an10.96:13.3: Antavā loko … pe … anantavā loko … taṃ jīvaṃ taṃ sarīraṃ … aññaṃ jīvaṃ aññaṃ sarīraṃ … hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā … na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā … hoti ca na ca hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā …‘neva hoti na na hoti tathāgato paraṃ maraṇā, idameva saccaṃ moghamaññan’ti kho, āvuso, diṭṭhigatametaṃ.
segments.an10.96:14.1: “Yāvatā, āvuso, diṭṭhi [diṭṭhigatā (sabbattha)] yāvatā diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhiadhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamuṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhisamugghāto [yāvatā diṭṭhiṭṭhāna adhiṭṭhāna pariyuṭṭhāna samuṭṭhāna samugghāto (sī. pī.)], tamahaṃ jānāmi tamahaṃ passāmi.
segments.an10.96:14.2: Tamahaṃ jānanto tamahaṃ passanto kyāhaṃ vakkhāmi –
segments.an10.96:15.1: “Ko nāmo āyasmā, kathañca panāyasmantaṃ sabrahmacārī jānantī”ti?
segments.an10.96:15.4: “Mahācariyena vata kira, bho, saddhiṃ mantayamānā na jānimha –
segments.an10.96:15.7: ‘ayaṃ āyasmā ānando’ti, ettakampi no nappaṭibhāyeyya [nappaṭibhāseyyāma (ka.) nappaṭibhāseyya (bahūsu) ma. ni.3.216 passitabbaṃ].

lines: Yāvatā, āvuso, diṭṭhīti yattikā dvāsaṭṭhividhāpi diṭṭhi nāma atthi.

Yāvatā diṭṭhiṭṭhānanti “khandhāpi diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ, avijjāpi, phassopi, saññāpi, vitakkopi ayonisomanasikāropi, pāpamittopi, paratoghosopi diṭṭhiṭṭhānan”ti evaṃ yattakaṃ aṭṭhavidhampi diṭṭhiṭṭhānaṃ diṭṭhikāraṇaṃ nāma atthi.
Diṭṭhādhiṭṭhānanti diṭṭhīnaṃ adhiṭṭhānaṃ, adhiṭhatvā adhibhavitvā pavattāya diṭṭhiyā etaṃ nāmaṃ.

Yā diṭṭhi diṭṭhigataṃ diṭṭhigahanaṃ diṭṭhikantāraṃ diṭṭhivisūkaṃ diṭṭhivipphanditaṃ diṭṭhisaṃyojanaṃ diṭṭhisallaṃ diṭṭhisambādho diṭṭhipalibodho diṭṭhibandhanaṃ diṭṭhipapāto diṭṭhānusayo diṭṭhisantāpo diṭṭhipariḷāho diṭṭhigantho diṭṭhupādānaṃ diṭṭhābhiniveso diṭṭhiparāmāso.
Imāni aṭṭhārasa diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānānī”ti evaṃ vuttaṃ diṭṭhipariyuṭṭhānaṃ.
“khandhā paccayo diṭṭhīnaṃ upādāya samuṭṭhānaṭṭhenā”ti (paṭi. ma.1.124) sabbaṃ vitthāretabbaṃ.
Yā diṭṭhīti idāni vuccamānānaṃ aṭṭhārasannaṃ padānaṃ sādhāraṇaṃ mūlapadaṃ.
Diṭṭhiyeva diṭṭhigataṃ gūthagataṃ viya, diṭṭhīsu vā gataṃ idaṃ dassanaṃ dvāsaṭṭhidiṭṭhīsu antogadhattātipi diṭṭhigataṃ, diṭṭhiyā vā gataṃ diṭṭhigataṃ.
Idañhi “atthi me attā”tiādi diṭṭhiyā gamanamattameva, natthettha attā vā nicco vā kocīti vuttaṃ hoti.
Kadāci sassatassa, kadāci ucchedassa vā gahaṇato virūpaṃ phanditanti vipphanditaṃ.
Diṭṭhiyeva anto tudanaṭṭhena dunnīharaṇīyaṭṭhena ca sallanti diṭṭhisallaṃ.
Diṭṭhiyeva “idaṃ paran”ti āmasati, parato vā āmasatīti diṭṭhiparāmāso, samuṭṭhāti etenāti samuṭṭhānaṃ, kāraṇaṃ.
Samuṭṭhānassa bhāvo samuṭṭhānaṭṭho, tena samuṭṭhānaṭṭhena, kāraṇabhāvenāti attho.
